text:
kai: Prom alert: ECC correctable errors leapt on us-west-gpu-pool. 4 nodes showing repeated reboots (XID 31) in last 4m. I'm adding them to the suspect list and starting coordination.
ops-bot: [alert] ECC_CORRECTABLE_RATE high on us-west-gpu-pool (threshold 50/min) — incident id INC-2109876543.
anya: copying. is traffic affected yet? any active customer jobs on those nodes?
mike: noticed ~15–25% tail latency on small-gen routes; batch queues backed up briefly. Most infra autoscaled but jobs stuck retrying.
linh: I'm pulling node list now — suspected: gw-usw-03, gw-usw-07, gw-usw-11, gw-usw-15. Planning a targeted drain + live-migrate of KV caches.
kai: start with gw-usw-03 and gw-usw-07. runbook step: `./scripts/drain_node --node gw-usw-03 --force --wait 300`. share logs when done.
linh: running drain on gw-usw-03 -> `drain started` (eta 5m). will not reboot until evacuated.
rachel: prepping routing changes: will shift critical routes to eu-west and ap-sg. non-critical/low-priority traffic will queue or fall back to smaller model variants.
mike: heads-up: cross-region failover increases egress and instance spin-up costs. rough addtl cost ~ $420/hr if we sustain full failover. recommend only critical routes for now.
anya: customer-impact list: two paying customers on dedicated instances in us-west — they can't be shifted. need to mark them and notify support immediately.
sre-oncall: marking as P1 for infra. if drain fails or new reboots occur, we'll trigger regional maintenance and block new allocs to pool.
linh: drain complete for gw-usw-03, no failed migrations. starting gw-usw-07.
kai: check kernel logs for ECC deltas: `journalctl -k -u nvidia-driver | grep -i ecc` and `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC`. Also try flushing KV cache for model-serving to see if error rate drops.
ops-bot: runbook action posted: routing-change-2109876590 (applied to critical routes only).
mike: I've updated autoscaler to prefer eu-west reserved pools for critical routes and to avoid preemptible spots for those customers.
linh: gw-usw-07 drain hit stuck pods (long-lived streams). forced drain succeeded after `--grace-period 60 --delete-local-data`. pods restarted in eu-west.
kai: one node (gw-usw-11) just rebooted unexpectedly and reported ECC uncorrectable on POST. I'm isolating it and will power it off.
hw-team: opened hardware ticket with vendor: https://vendor.example.com/rma/CH-99823. RMA ETA 48h, ordering 2 spare GPU modules and 1 replacement node.
mike: schedule: continue rolling drains, keep capacity conservative. we should enable model-quant fallback for affected routes to reduce token use while we reshuffle. kai, can you flip fallback?
kai: enabling fallback to quantized:model-blue-7b on route /v1/generate for tenants tagged `graceful-fallback`. should cut token throughput ~30%.
rachel: posting customer advisory to support and sending targeted pings to the two dedicated customers.
anya: confirm we should block new allocations to us-west-gpu-pool until we have spares or hardware swapped?
sre-oncall: yes block new allocations and put pool in degraded mode. set SLA alert to mute non-critical.
mike: create billing note for cost center — we will route traffic cross-region, flagging additional egress.
linh: finishing drain on gw-usw-11, preparing node for RMA imaging. collecting dmesg and nvlog: attaching to ticket.
kai: quick check — try `nvidia-smi -pm 1` and `nvidia-smi -dmon -s u` to monitor ECC stats while we keep pool isolated. also consider firmware rollback if we see correlation with last driver update.
hw-team: confirmed vendor asked for nvlog and serials; RMA created CH-99823. spare shipment initiated, ETA 48h.
ops-bot: scheduled job: auto-rebalance to eu-west at 2109876820 applied (partial).
mike: agree on limited shift; cost flagged, approvals pending from finance.
rachel: I'll book hot-swap window at 03:00 UTC if nodes still failing by tomorrow. posting maintenance notice.
linh: ack, will keep node list pinned in incident doc.
kai: thanks all — main actions: drains done for two nodes, one node isolated for RMA, routing changed for critical routes to eu-west/ap-sg, fallback to quantized model enabled, vendor RMA open. please keep channel updated with any new XID or reboots. :thumbsup:
mike: I'll update infra runbook and post a short summary in #incidents once we close the loop.
anya: pinging support to start customer outreach now.
ops-bot: incident INC-2109876543 status: active -> mitigated (partial).
